provider_receipt.summary: Cannot approve the joined result: the supplied close receipts contain only closure status and no implementation, analytical result, or verification evidence establishing the full approved objective; the parent verification receipt proves only a clean tree. Independent inspection also found security/privacy defects contradicting the ingestion contract: src/lib.rs:184-192 resolves absolute and parent-traversal wikilinks without enforcing the vault boundary, allowing backlinks to expose paths outside the vault; src/lib.rs:110-124 silently discards traversal errors and ingests every Markdown note into memory without classifying status, authority, privacy, or review requirements; and src/lib.rs:56-89 reports successful storage while only serializing and discarding the record, providing no durable memory or provenance. No project files were modified and no declared checks were rerun.
